sections.Profile:
Bus Stop , produced by Bally Manufacturing Co. in December 1964, is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Ted Zale with artwork by Art Stenholm. The game features a travel theme and includes notable gameplay mechanics like two flippers, three pop bumpers, six mushroom bumpers, and two kick-out holes.
